title: Acquire useful graph-code generators by their actual trace-variable cost
statement: Support kernels manufacture all short(a,Ba) words; weighted matroid greedy minimizes total X cost at each attainable rank. A hidden family loses at most floor(Wstar/(w+1)) rank under support truncation, and each selected X update adds two phase variables while Z actions add none.

requires: Raw alternating matrix, explicit support limit and X-cost budget
Stream all kernel combinations, not only a chosen basis
provides: Support kernels manufacture all short(a,Ba) words; weighted matroid greedy minimizes total X cost at each attainable rank. A hidden family loses at most floor(Wstar/(w+1)) rank under support truncation, and each selected X update adds two phase variables while Z actions add none.
assumptions: Keep the qB(a) sign and Z-before-X action
A generic dense B may have no useful short words
costs: N=r+2A,2^delta branches, denominator2^A; charge every introduced state and exact reconstruction
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; exact binary/cyclotomic/finite-field arithmetic and source-local rank parameters. No physical resource conversion.
contract.obstruction: Sparse joint support and sparse X cost are different acquisition objectives.

body: This interface can cover an n-dimensional primitive cyclic cubic block through a favorable corrupted sparse-inverse quadratic background.
